stage: PRE-REGISTERED mechanism probe: is the transformer's recall failure representational (circuit absent) or behavioural (circuit present, unused)?
design: Seed-matched pairs: for each seed, one 8-layer attention model (layout AAAAAAAA) and one candidate model (CCCCCCCC) trained identically at the same budget. Pairing is deliberate and the analysis is paired -- see SEED-AND-STATISTICS-AUDIT.md, which found the programme's sealed campaigns are all seed-paired while reporting unpaired Fisher tests. This campaign reports McNemar exact / paired statistics as primary from the outset.
primary_endpoint: layer-wise linear decodability of the answer token from the residual stream at the query position, train/test on disjoint sequences; chance = 1/NVAL = 0.0625
secondary_endpoint: transition_count (recall > 0.8), reproducing the known pattern as a built-in positive control

preregistered_predictions.positive_control: candidate arm crosses in most pairs (q observed 13/16 at this configuration) and transformer arm crosses in none. If this does not reproduce, the campaign is INCONCLUSIVE and the probe numbers are not interpreted.
preregistered_predictions.probe_validity_gate: the shuffled-label control must land within 0.02 of chance (0.0625) for every model. Any model failing this has a leaking probe and is excluded, not explained.
preregistered_predictions.outcome_A_circuit_absent: transformer probe accuracy <= chance + 0.05 at every layer while candidate probe accuracy is far above chance. SUPPORTS the current strong framing: attention does not acquire the circuit at this budget.
preregistered_predictions.outcome_B_circuit_unused: transformer probe accuracy >= chance + 0.20 at any layer while its output recall stays at chance. WEAKENS the current framing materially: the information is present and the failure is one of readout/optimization, not representation. This outcome must be reported as prominently as outcome A, in the abstract, not buried in limitations.
preregistered_predictions.outcome_C_intermediate: anything between the two thresholds is reported as indeterminate and neither framing is claimed.
preregistered_predictions.measured_probe_floor: A pipeline smoke test at a 300x smaller budget (neither arm learns; recall 0.089/0.103) gave probe_best 0.099 and 0.097 against chance 0.0625, with shuffled controls at 0.058/0.060. So the probe reads ~0.03 above chance on a model that has learned nothing -- weak positional/frequency structure, not the retrieval circuit. The outcome-A threshold (chance + 0.05) is set above this measured floor deliberately; outcome B (chance + 0.20) is far above it.

commitment: Both outcomes are publishable and the prediction is timestamped into the append-only ledger before any model is trained. No efficacy stopping; all 8 pairs run to completion regardless of interim values.
cost: zero cloud spend; local V100s, ~1.1h per shard
